name: Lima Design System
description: How the Lima token files combine. Sets are always applied; each modifier contributes exactly one of its contexts.

base.description: Raw scales: sizes, type scale, durations and easings. Not for direct use in product code.

functional.description: Tokens named for what they are used for. Independent of color mode and input device.

theme.description: Color mode. Every color, shadow and border token is defined once per context.

pointer.description: Primary input device. Touch targets and control spacing grow for coarse pointers.
